narrationScript: Welcome to our deep dive into SQL Fundamentals. In this chapter, we're going to unlock the power of databases by learning how to communicate with them using Structured Query Language, or SQL. SQL isn't a general-purpose programming language like Python; it's a specialized, declarative language. This means you tell the database *what* you want, and it figures out *how* to get it. Our primary focus will be on the most essential SQL command: `SELECT`, which is all about retrieving data. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to construct basic `SELECT` statements, specify which tables to pull from using `FROM`, and filter your results precisely with the `WHERE` clause. You'll also learn the difference between grabbing all columns versus just a few, and effectively use comparison and logical operators to fine-tune your queries.
